description: Create an Airflow DAG for fintech_app that loads end-of-day FX rates and revalues open positions. The DAG should: (1) use DateTimeSensorAsync to wait until 17:15 America/New_York on the logical date (rates are published at 17:00 NY time), (2) call the rates provider and store rates for the logical date, (3) wait with an ExternalTaskSensor for the positions_snapshot DAG's 'publish' task of the same logical date, (4) compute revaluation P&L by joining positions to rates, (5) write results partitioned by valuation_date. The DAG is scheduled daily at 00:00 UTC, Monday through Friday only.

schema.source: rates provider REST endpoint /eod?date={{ ds }}, risk.positions_snapshot

edge_cases: With cron '0 0 * * 1-5' the Friday data interval is processed by the run that starts Monday; valuation_date must be data_interval_start's date, not the run's start date
17:15 New York is 21:15 or 22:15 UTC depending on DST; the target time must be computed in the NY timezone
Positions with a currency missing from the rates table must be reported, not silently dropped
ExternalTaskSensor must match the same logical date; the upstream DAG has an identical schedule so no execution_delta is needed
common_failure_modes: FM2: Hard-coding 22:15 UTC makes the DAG fetch rates an hour early during daylight saving time
FM1: INNER JOIN between positions and rates drops positions in currencies with no published rate
FM6: ExternalTaskSensor with a wrong execution_delta waits forever for a run that does not exist
